name: doto_jutsu0_initialize
comment: Resource 59 (Black Dragon Blizzard) vtable +0x198.

name: doto_jutsu0_process
comment: At controller frame 15 spawns doto_jutsu0_dragon (0xAB0, vtable 0x005C75E0), a facing-dependent particle generator and common sounds 0x0E/0x27; ends on the animation's last frame.

name: doto_jutsu0_dragon_setup
comment: Plays ANM_pdtucha01 on its own controller and binds OBJ_krh00t0 bone01..13 as the dragon's 13 hit shapes; at most 3 hits (+0x5DE).

name: doto_jutsu0_dragon_update
comment: Dragon states 0..5, 7 end: launch, follow the 13 bone shapes, query contacts (0x007C08D0), trail generator, end after the animation loops.

name: jutsu_create_for_resource
comment: Resource below 0x48: switch through jutsu_factory_table (0x008AC240). 59 -> 0x3C0 doto_jutsu0 (base 0x007C4140, vtable 0x005C7640); 60 -> 0x6B0 doto_jutsu1_construct.

name: doto_jutsu1_construct
comment: Resource 60 (2dtucha1, 氷遁 双龍暴風雪): base 0x007C4140, vtable 0x005C05A0, three 0x50 entries at +0x3A0.

name: doto_jutsu1_process
comment: Resource 60 (Twin Dragon Blizzard): updates three attached effect entries, queries contacts at controller frames 33 and 43, loops common sound 0x0E every 10 updates.

name: doto_jutsu1_initialize
comment: Resource 60 vtable +0x198.

name: doto_jutsu0_destruct
comment: Resource 59 actor destructor (vtable 0x005C7640, then base vtable 0x005C7340).

name: stage_select_thumbnail_origins
comment: Same values as US 0x0081C6A0; 16/17 are the snow scenes' thumbnails.

name: stage_select_preview_texture_names
comment: haipure01..04 name pointers.

name: stage_scene_tables
comment: 18 scene record lists and null; same records as US 0x0081C760.

name: jutsu_resource_filenames

name: jutsu_selector_resource_table

name: jutsu_factory_table
